spans.s:
índra, m. Indra, name of a Vedic god; in
the later language, the best of its kind,
chief, prince. [none of the numerous
proposed derivations is satisfactory.]

índra-purogama, a. having Indra as
leader, preceded by Indra. [1302c 2.]

índra-śatru, a. having Indra as his
conqueror. [1302.]

indrāgní, m. Indra and Agni. [índra +
agní: acct, 1255b.]

indrāyudha, n. Indra's weapon, the
rainbow. [āyudha.]

indriyá, a. belonging to Indra; as n.
 —1. the quality pertaining especially to
Indra, i. e. great might, power, 73^18, 97^6;
 —2. in general, one of a man's powers, i. e.
a sense or organ of sense. [índra, 1214b.]
